The Invitation

To the Woman
Holding It All Together.

This sanctuary is built for those of us who carry massive projects, businesses, teams, and the continuous weight of intellectual responsibility. When your mind operates at its maximum for too long, your nervous system quietly builds a defensive armor. Your body begins to hold stress deep within its muscle tissue and fascia—shortening your breath, locking you into a loop of background anxiety that no strategy session can resolve.

You do not need to be fixed, or taught how to live. You are already whole. But when your head is running a marathon and your body is simply begging for permission to exhale—to put down the armor, to stop controlling—this is where you belong.

We gather here to help you return to your primal state: a living, sensing, deeply grounded human being.

The Method

Why the Mind
Cannot Heal the Mind.

When the nervous system is held in a chronic survival loop—fight, flight, freeze—conventional talk therapy and executive coaching inevitably hit a ceiling. The head cannot fix the head. To unlock the mind, we must enter through the body, on a pre-verbal level.

Our methodology bypasses the mental guardian through a precisely designed therapeutic sequence.

01
Softening the Control — The Resonance Sessions
We begin with deep group somatic work. Through tailored breathwork, sound healing with a tongue drum, and vocal toning, we signal absolute safety to the vagus nerve and the brain. The cortical grip relaxes, allowing the body to release its defensive vigilance and drop into presence.
02
Structural Decompression — The Pravilo Frame
Only after the nervous system has surrendered through sound do we transition to individual sessions on the Pravilo frame. Because the body is no longer bracing, the frame safely decompresses the spine, opens tight joints, and gently releases long-held emotional and physical tension stored in the myofascial layers.
03
Integration — The Sanctuary Field
Every somatic release needs a container to land in. Within the women's circle, we gently unpack, process, and ground each shift—converting raw physical release into lasting inner stability. This is where the work becomes permanent.
The Pravilo Practice

The Sacred Geometry
of Decompression.

The Pravilo frame is used here not as a tool for physical endurance, but as a path to somatic de-armoring. It is a non-invasive decompression, tailored precisely to the limits of your nervous system. By gently suspending the body by its four extremities using its own weight, Pravilo achieves what no massage table can.

The Pravilo frame, Ubud, Bali — suspending the body in sacred geometry.
Spinal & Joint Decompression
Gravity naturally opens space between the vertebrae, relieving years of micro-compression on spinal discs and joints. Many women describe immediate relief after the very first session.
Fascial Unpacking
Our mental armor lives in the deep connective tissue. Pravilo delicately stretches these layers, releasing crystallized emotional blocks and structural fatigue stored at a cellular level.
Neurological Surrender
As the body gently expands, the brain receives a definitive chemical signal: it is safe to stop bracing. Chronic muscle tension dissolves, returning the body to its state of primal fluidity.
The Sanctuary Field

A Space to Put Down
the Armor.

When you lead companies, build businesses, or carry the weight of continuous responsibility, your brain adapts by wearing invisible armor around the clock. You are required to be strong, flawless, and strategic. But where over-control rules, there is no room for your raw, authentic self to simply breathe.

The heart of our retreat is the Sanctuary Field—a safe, confidential container of our conscious women's circles. A space entirely stripped of judgment, competition, or corporate status. There are no leaders or subordinates here; only human beings sharing a profound journey of undoing.

I
A Deep Evolutionary Need
Since the dawn of humanity, individuals gathered in close-knit groups to find absolute safety among their own. Our nervous system requires co-regulation—the profound experience of being seen, heard, and accepted exactly as you are, without your social roles or protective facades. It is not a luxury; it is a primal biological necessity.
II
Clinical Safety & Therapeutic Holding
Because this field is held under Anastasiia's direct guidance as a professional therapist, the process is fully integrated, ecologically sound, and safe for everyone. She holds the container so your psyche can step down from high vigilance and drop into its deepest state of rest.
The Seven Days

The Method
in Action.

Day One
The Arrival & Grounding
Shifting from the frequency of high speed to presence.
Private airport transfers to Ubud, check-in, and spatial adaptation. Opening our first Sanctuary Field—a soft introduction, releasing the first layers of external control, and a welcome dinner by our private chef.
Day Two
Delayering the Mind
Initiating pre-verbal somatic work and softening the mental guard.
Morning somatic alignment. First immersive group Resonance Session—deep breathwork, vocal toning, and sound healing with a tongue drum. Evening integration within the Sanctuary Field. The cortical grip begins, for the first time, to loosen.
Day Three
The Primal Realignment
First deep physical release and fascial de-armoring.
The entire cohort travels to a private, closed location for our first Pravilo Workshop. While each woman takes her turn on the frame under Anastasiia's clinical supervision, the group holds the field through collective breath and sound.
Day Four
Ancient Cleansing — Melukat
The equator of the retreat. Washing away the old self.
A journey to a sacred Balinese water temple for the traditional Melukat purification ritual. Return to the villa for a light fusion dinner and a stabilizing evening somatic meditation.
Day Five
The Deepest Unpacking
Accessing the oldest layers of cortisol armor now moved to the surface.
Our second closed-door Pravilo Workshop. Deepening the fascial matrix work initiated on Day Three. The cohort co-regulates the intense somatic energy together, followed by an evening of raw honesty within the Sanctuary Field.
Day Six
Returning to the Primal State
Recalibrating the system. Filling the inner space with absolute silence.
A final group Resonance session to anchor the new breathing patterns. A grand closing Circle of Gratitude. Celebration dinner. The retreat does not end—it completes.
Day Seven
Re-entering the World
An ecological transition back into your life—from total alignment.
Morning completion circle, farewell embraces, and private transfers to the airport. You return not as the same woman who arrived. The beginning of a new era of radical internal freedom.
Your Facilitator

Held by
a Professional.

Master of Psychology · Somatic Educator · Architect of Human Experiences

I spent years exploring a single question: how can a person operating under extreme mental load drop their defenses, release accumulated stress, and return to their primal, unshakeable peace?

Anastasiia approaches human transformation through a rare and precise intersection: the rigorous frameworks of Western psychology and the deep, pre-verbal power of Eastern somatic practices.

She holds a Master's degree in Psychology, specializing in how the nervous system processes chronic stress and over-control. Her professional geography spans years of creating intentional communities and guiding deep somatic programs across Vienna, Bali, and Portugal.

Anastasiia is the founder of Neo Healing and creator of the Neo Healing Protocol. Her signature approach is designed specifically for leaders, entrepreneurs, and creators who have mastered the art of control but forgotten the language of safety.

On this retreat, she holds the entire therapeutic container—ensuring every breakthrough and emotional shift is processed with absolute psychological safety and profound human warmth.
